mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 3-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.0% in the prior month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad-based consumer demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue expectations, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return prediction fails in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes where industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, manufacturing output contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and lower earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 95.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses short-term discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants adjust equity valuations rapidly.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals dual stress on consumer demand and labor market health, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced spending power and confidence.
failure_condition: Negative return prediction fails in more than 55% of instances where HOUST declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
